title: A Vibe whose evening a liked film fits without saying why they liked it, and one it does not fit
construction_note: docs/work/vibe-hypotheses. The Brothers Bloom is absent on purpose: the request introduces it. It belongs on Champagne & Blueprints' evening — a crew, a plan, beautiful places — and nothing there says what they gave as the reason, clever characters doing smart things. Reading Room is an evening it is not, so where it belongs is a judgement, not the only Vibe there is. Every core is a film they loved.
